children: West Coast Community authorized a share repurchase program of up to $25 million, set to expire December 31, 2028.
The program permits open-market and privately negotiated repurchases as market conditions warrant.
Repurchases are discretionary; the program does not require the company to buy a specified number of shares.
The company expects to use internal funds, supplemented as needed by a dividend from West Coast Community Bank.
Repurchases are subject to customary regulatory approvals or non-objections, and the program may be changed or ended without notice.
